contracts.label: OpenAI Platform organization usage and costs
contracts.apiVersion: Current Organization API reference; endpoint paths are not date-versioned
contracts.auth: Organization Admin API key with read access to organization usage and costs
contracts.pagination: Cursor pagination through next_page while has_more is true; query scope must remain unchanged
contracts.units: Usage totals are inclusive input_tokens/output_tokens; modality and cache fields are breakdowns. Cost amount.value carries its currency.
contracts.currency: Use the Costs API currency and amount; never derive billed money from Usage API tokens
contracts.window: start_time inclusive and end_time exclusive for an explicitly reported Unix-second interval
contracts.freshnessAndRevision: Treat API results as provider-reported accrued cost/usage for the requested interval; final invoice, credits, tax, discounts and later adjustments remain separate
contracts.reconciliationAnchor: OpenAI Costs export or invoice-detail export for the identical organization scope and period
exclusions: ChatGPT and Codex workspace seats, credits and subscription invoices
Prepaid credit application, tax, refunds, discounts and final cash settlement
Usage endpoints other than the connector's explicitly fetched surfaces

requiredMarkers: across text, audio, and image outputs

contracts.label: Anthropic Platform Usage and Cost Admin API
contracts.auth: Claude Console organization Admin API key; unavailable to individual accounts and distinct from Enterprise Analytics keys
contracts.pagination: Follow has_more and next_page without changing the original query
contracts.units: Usage separates uncached input, cache creation/read, output and server tools. Cost amount is a decimal string in fractional cents.
contracts.currency: USD fractional cents divided by 100 using decimal-safe arithmetic
contracts.window: RFC3339 starting_at/ending_at with source-specific bucket widths; Claude Code analytics is daily
contracts.freshnessAndRevision: Usage/cost data normally appears within minutes; exact invoice settlement and Priority Tier cost remain outside the Cost endpoint
contracts.reconciliationAnchor: Claude Console cost export or invoice for the identical organization scope and period
exclusions: Priority Tier cost from the Cost endpoint
Claude Enterprise parent organizations and their Analytics-key-only data
Final invoice credits, tax, contract adjustments and payment status
Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry activity not returned by the named endpoints

contracts.label: Claude Enterprise Analytics
contracts.apiVersion: Claude Enterprise Analytics API current reference
contracts.auth: Analytics API key with read:analytics created by the Claude Enterprise primary owner; not interchangeable with an Admin API key
contracts.pagination: Cursors are bound to the original filters, grouping and period; changing scope requires restarting from page one
contracts.units: Analytics cost amounts are decimal fractional cents; organization total is authoritative for reported usage credits and per-user rows are attribution only
contracts.currency: Post-discount, pre-credit USD fractional cents for reported usage credits; not the contracted Enterprise seat invoice
contracts.window: Explicit ending_at at or before data_refreshed_at for stable cost/usage results
contracts.freshnessAndRevision: Cost and usage may be revised for up to 30 days; recent tails after data_refreshed_at are incomplete
contracts.reconciliationAnchor: Organization cost report older than the revision window reconciled separately from the matching Enterprise seat invoice/contract
exclusions: Credits, tax, contract true-ups and payment settlement
Contracted Enterprise seat charges are not reported by Analytics usage-credit cost rows
Per-user rows do not include unattributable automation/API traffic
RBAC-group rows can overlap and must not be summed
Claude Code through Amazon Bedrock

contracts.label: Gemini CLI and Google billing evidence
contracts.apiVersion: Gemini CLI session format is officially evolving; record the observed CLI version per fixture
contracts.auth: Local CLI evidence needs no cloud credential; billed money requires an authorized Google Cloud Billing export or account record
endpoints: Google Cloud Billing export to BigQuery
contracts.pagination: Local sessions are bounded files; Cloud Billing export completeness is established by the chosen billing account, table and period
contracts.units: Input, output, cached, thought, tool and total tokens where the session record supplies complete components; thought is priced as output only when the dated pricing contract supports it
contracts.currency: Local tokens are API-equivalent value only; Cloud Billing export currency establishes provider-reported money
contracts.window: Session timestamps for local evidence; explicit billing export usage period for cash
contracts.freshnessAndRevision: Unknown shapes, auth modes, project hashes and token components remain missing; billing export revisions follow Google Cloud Billing
contracts.reconciliationAnchor: Google Cloud Billing detailed or FOCUS export for the same project/billing account and period
exclusions: logs.json is presence-only and never financial evidence
Opaque project hashes are not reversed or guessed
Free, subscription and pay-as-you-go auth modes are not inferred
Local session value is not a Google invoice

contracts.label: Cursor Admin API spending and usage events
contracts.apiVersion: Current Cursor Admin API reference; no date-version header
contracts.auth: Cursor team Admin API key via HTTP Basic authentication
contracts.pagination: One-indexed page/pageSize; complete all reported pages and prove member/event coverage for the requested scope
contracts.units: Use spendCents/overallSpendCents aggregates and chargedCents event details as provider fields; preserve model, kind, usage pool, Cursor Token Rate context, Max mode and token/cache splits without repricing
contracts.currency: Provider cents divided by 100 only after event detail reconciles to the matching aggregate; keep Cursor Models, Other Models, included, on-demand and BYOK bases separate
contracts.window: Team spend is the current subscription cycle; filtered events use inclusive epoch-millisecond bounds and hourly aggregation
contracts.freshnessAndRevision: Polling guidance is hourly; incomplete pagination or event/aggregate residual remains partial/missing
contracts.reconciliationAnchor: Sum filtered usage-event chargedCents and reconcile to /teams/spend for the identical current cycle, then compare with invoice/export
exclusions: Undocumented local IDE/CLI stores are not financial evidence
Included usage is not silently treated as incremental cash
Usage-pool and Cursor Token Rate terms are pricing context, not a license to reconstruct billed cost from token counts
A fixture-only connector is not live or invoice reconciliation
Seat contracts, tax, credits and final invoice adjustments

contracts.label: GitHub Copilot AI-credit billing
contracts.auth: Organization or enterprise administrator/billing manager using a fine-grained token or GitHub App with read Administration permission
endpoints: Copilot seats and organization metrics APIs
implementedEndpoints: Copilot seats and organization metrics APIs
contracts.pagination: AI-credit reports are period/filter scoped; seats and metrics retain their own pagination/completeness contracts
contracts.units: Preserve product, SKU, model, unit type, price per unit, gross/discount/net quantities and amounts; keep adoption metrics and seats separate
contracts.currency: Use provider grossAmount, discountAmount and netAmount; one AI credit is the provider billing unit and not a token
contracts.window: Explicit organization/enterprise year, month and optional day; only the past 24 months are available on the AI-credit endpoint
contracts.freshnessAndRevision: The current dated API version is required; preview endpoints remain subject to change and incomplete access stays missing
contracts.reconciliationAnchor: Organization or enterprise AI-credit report reconciled to the matching billing usage summary and invoice period
exclusions: User-level endpoints when the organization or enterprise pays
Seat count and adoption metrics are not incremental AI-credit spend
Premium-request legacy units are not silently blended with AI credits
Tax, contract true-ups, credits and invoice payment settlement

requiredMarkers: GitHub AI Credits are the billing unit
